purpose: Descriptors of the kinds whose new object the Configurator fills in its own way, as it writes them right after interactive creation. A new language takes the first free numbered code ru1, ru2 from the Configurator's interface language, whatever the languages of the configuration. Location, Use, Documents and the Group of a common command stay empty: the platform will not load these kinds until the property is set. object.create writes the same bytes; loading such a dump refuses with «Не установлено Хранение функциональной опции», «Не установлено Использование параметра функциональной опции», «Не один документ не участвует в последовательности» and «Не указана группа, в которую входит команда по умолчанию». A new common command gets the handler module in the script variant of the configuration: ОбщаяКоманда1 comes from a Russian configuration, CommonCommand1 from one with ScriptVariant English. A new style, bot or WebSocket client gets no module.

steps.tool: Configurator, interactive: add the object and save the configuration
